name: Fluid Shader
tagline: A landing-page hero around a gentle liquid you can touch: glowing dye, liquid chrome, marbled ink or a soap film.
youSay: /fluid-shader a launch page for Tincture, a colour-grading app
whatYouGet: A landing page whose hero is a liquid you can touch: glowing colour in dark water, liquid chrome, marbled ink or a soap film
A delicate touch: the cursor draws the liquid along (or lights the chrome) and a click lets something open slowly
The page around it: brand, copy, type and a layout made for the look, on wide screens, tall windows and phones
A static site with no libraries: one small WebGL2 engine, a CSS fallback and a still frame for reduced motion
goodFit: Creative tools, audio and hardware, stationery and craft, beauty and skincare
Launch pages that want an interactive, tactile first screen
notFor: Pages that need a photo or product image as the hero
Loud, high-energy splash effects (the liquid is kept calm)
youBring: What the page is for and the brand name
Optional: colours, mood, headline and fonts
